title: 🎆 @Monday.R-1 routing in shadow
text: Here is the result of "fetch" for the Page with URL https://app.notion.com/p/41a4a78a1c8780be9c83d3f02a810d07 as of 2026-11-19T22:54:03.712Z: {"Last edited":"2026-11-19T22:54:03.712Z","Name":".R-1 routing in shadow","Priority":"p0","Status":"In progress","date:Period:is_datetime":0,"date:Period:start":"2026-11-16","url":"https://app.notion.com/p/41a4a78a1c8780be9c83d3f02a810d07"} {"type":"emoji","emoji":"🎆"} # Plan 1. Redeploy the autoeval-replay cron from current main (Jean): git fetch origin && git checkout origin/main, then uv run rd modal deploy cron prod autoeval-replay. Starts the judged auto_route leg from [PR 15021](https://github.com/reductoai/api/pull/15021). 2. Read results: judge score per leg. Routed should beat R-1 mini alone. - Routed share is the mean of auto_routed on the routed rows. - Leave out rows with auto_route_outcome=mini_failed: b200-route has no warm floor, so a cold start can send a page to R-1 without the head. ## Promote to prod Plan for Jean's stamp: three PRs that turn on routing for auto_route pages in prod, with the route head at threshold 0.58. Requests without auto_route don't change. Today an auto_route page calls the Modal R-1 mini class directly. That class has no route head (the classifier that sends each page to R-1 mini or R-1), so nothing gets routed. ### Jean's calls 1. Scope. Default: opt-in auto_route jobs only. Alternative: all R-1 mini traffic, which needs the fpp-35b guarantee resized first. 2. Route head. Default: ship the current one now, swap in the retrained one after tomorrow's new R-1. Alternative: wait for the retrain (paused until the new R-1). ### Plan 1. Make the routed variant the R-1 mini Modal pick in stg, prod and prod\_eu together. - New variant at 128 seats, named by checkpoint date (the shadow build has 42). - Ships its performance table: one container, B200 and B300. - Gate: c=512 stress test on one container at 128 seats; unrouted output identical to today's pick. - prod\_au stays as is: it has no R-1 to route to. - Rollback: point the pick back to b200-n128 and redeploy all regions. 2. Add the route head to the fpp-2b image on all three US clusters in one Flux rollout. - The patch targets the Modal image (vLLM 0.31); cluster fpp-2b runs Dynamo on vLLM 0.33, so it needs a port. - Gate: the same pages get the same route head score on cluster fpp-2b and on Modal. - Rollback: previous image tag. 3. Send auto_route pages through the inference router: cluster first, Modal spill. - Today the worker skips the router for them because cluster fpp-2b has no route head. - Rollback: revert; pages call Modal directly again. 4. Raise the R-1 worker waiting limit from 2 to 6 on all clusters, in one Flux rollout. - Problem: at a full cluster, burst workers refuse calls (529), which go straight to Modal: 411 on Nov 19, 06:00 to 14:00 PT, against 61 on Nov 17. Since [#15259](https://github.com/reductoai/api/pull/15259) the head splits calls between the baseline and burst pools at random, by worker count, so the small burst pool overflows. - Evidence (uss1, Nov 19, 09:55 to 09:58 PT): both pools took 7.9 calls/s per worker, yet each burst worker refused 24.6 calls a minute and each baseline worker 0.05. The router had leased every seat (393 of 440 in flight, 853 queued). The random split predicts about 300 burst refusals per baseline one; we measured 406 to 1. Samples are 15 s apart, so the burst pool passing its 132 seats is inferred. - Change: DYN_DYNAMO_REQUEST_QUEUE_LIMIT 2 to 6 for fpp-35b. The waiting limit is how many calls a worker queues before it refuses more. Spare room in a 6-worker burst pool goes from 12 to 36 seats. - Cost: an overflowing call waits behind 20 busy seats (0.6 to 0.7 s) instead of going to Modal at once. - Gate: head 529s per day, direct Modal calls and R-1 p99, before and after. Rollback: set it back to 2. - If not enough: dynamo-stable picks the pool by free seats, not worker count (new image and rollout). ### Cluster capacity - No change to the stamped [B200 sharing plan](https://app.notion.com/p/41c4a78a1c878179a3f4d03746e1ad63). fpp-2b keeps its 3 guaranteed B200s per cluster. Routed pages land on fpp-35b's guarantee (16 on uss1 and use1, 25 on usw3) and burst into shared GPUs (9 off-peak, 6 on weekdays, none on usw3). - Load: at 0.58 the route head sent 28% of pages to R-1 (780 judged pages, Nov 18), so every 100 auto_route pages add about 28 R-1 pages. - B300: the Modal class asks for "B200 or better", and the routed build ran 10.8 pages/s on a B300 against 19.8 on a B200. PR 1's performance run finds the cause; if it isn't fixed, PR 1 pins the class to B200. ### Cost per 1k pages GPU at saturation, from the registry tables: R-1 mini \$0.08, R-1 \$0.13, routed R-1 mini at 28% about \$0.10 (estimate). A routed page bills the customer at the R-1 rate. I'll measure cost per call before and after the cutover. # Logs - \[2026-11-16 11:45 PT\] In progress: [PR 14939](https://github.com/reductoai/api/pull/14939) adds settings.alpha.auto_route. R-1 mini's route head sends the pages it scores hard to R-1, and a job whose org has filled its R-1 mini pool runs on R-1. - \[2026-11-16 12:13 PT\] Pushed both review fixes: an AU job at its R-1 mini limit stays on R-1 mini ([aec894b](https://github.com/reductoai/api/pull/14939/commits/aec894ba4b)), and the head weights moved from git to Hugging Face at a pinned commit, with their env var in the registry ([792b5bf](https://github.com/reductoai/api/pull/14939/commits/792b5bf9df)). Uploaded with Jean's HF write token. - All four review threads answered and resolved; CI green. - \[2026-11-16 12:35 PT\] Codex re-reviewed the new head and raised three more on the full-pool rule. Fixed one (a split at the limit now moves to R-1 too, [88ebb26](https://github.com/reductoai/api/pull/14939/commits/88ebb2619d)); and the other two ([668f54d](https://github.com/reductoai/api/pull/14939/commits/668f54dd99)): the check now counts the job's own 3-page weight and ignores holds left by a dead worker. - \[2026-11-16 12:55 PT\] Ready to merge: CI green on 668f54d, every Codex and Devin Review thread resolved. One Codex P2 answered, not fixed: two jobs enqueued in the same instant can both read "fits", and the second waits on R-1 mini instead of moving to R-1 (no over-admission). - Not run: the image build with the downloaded weights (its download and checksum commands pass), and a routed page through a real worker. - \[2026-11-16 13:20 PT\] Per Jean, the head moved to its own variant b200-route (dev shadow only, [e602fdf](https://github.com/reductoai/api/pull/14939/commits/e602fdf195)); the default R-1 mini image is stock again. - \[2026-11-16 14:25 PT\] Ready to merge: CI green on c151ce0, Codex found nothing, every review thread resolved. Review fixes since: the full-pool check replays the pool's gate (wake of parked jobs, job priority), and a batch job moved to R-1 starts on the R-1 lane. - \[2026-11-16 14:40 PT\] In progress: [PR 15021](https://github.com/reductoai/api/pull/15021) (stacked on 14939) adds a third leg, R-1 mini + auto_route on b200-route, to the judged R-1 vs R-1 mini shadow. The two strict legs are unchanged. - Every leg's final output is judged against the same R-1 baseline, so routed vs R-1 mini alone reads off the dashboard. - Each routed row records where its page ran: routed, kept, mini_failed or pool_full. - Cost: one more one-page replay and judge call per pair, up to 1,000 pairs a day. - Not run: a real pair end to end (needs steps 1 and 2). - \[2026-11-17 10:38 PT\] Merged. Prod release with 14939 went out 2026-11-16 17:17 PT. The prod cron is still on the build from before the merge. - \[2026-11-17 11:50 PT\] Cron redeployed at 11:13 PT, but from an Oct 24 checkout (e47f597) without 15021. Its 11:45 PT submit sent no judged-shadow legs and restarted the paused 20260917_routed vs legacy experiment. No judged auto_route pair yet. - \[2026-11-16 15:20 PT\] Rebased onto main after 14939 merged. Deployed the routed dev class as its own app fpp-flash-b200-route (rd modal deploy single-model dev fpp-flash --env-var FPP_FLASH_SHADOW=b200-route); shared dev fpp-flash untouched. - Head checked directly on that class: a text page stays on R-1 mini, a chart page routes to R-1. - First request after the deploy waited about 7 min of 503s (no warm floor). - A judged pair end to end did not run: a staging worker gets 401 from Modal dev, and prod workers need the prod release. - \[2026-11-16 14:50 PT\] Earlier head, before the rebase: CI green on 0fc3b05, Codex found nothing, the one Devin Review finding (dashboard heading for the two candidates) fixed. Nov 17 (PT) Autoeval dashboard: routing section - #15201 ✅ + Deploy (dashboard 16:44, autoeval cron 17:15): routed share, outcome split, score vs share graph. Routed pages no longer read as "R-1 mini failed"; rows graded before 17:15 keep the old label until they leave the 24 h window. Warm dev classes for the shadow - #15221 ✅ + Deploy (dev, 17:24): the hourly dev cron sets a floor of 1 on the stock and routed dev R-1 mini classes at :35. - Why: a cold stock class lost every strict R-1 mini page in the 14:45 submit (204 attempts). The 16:45 and 17:45 submits then succeeded 53 of 53 and 52 of 52. - #15213 closed: a registry floor would also warm an idle B200 in every R-1 shadow's dev app. Head score log - Score log on in the routed dev class (redeployed 17:06). Scores join judged pairs by request id; no engine or gateway change. Threshold curve: 780 judged pages (Nov 18) The route head sends a page to R-1 when its score clears the threshold. Sweeping the threshold from never routing to always routing: | Point | Pages sent to R-1 | Mean judge score | | --- | --- | --- | | R-1 mini only | 0% | 9.12 | | Live threshold 0.58 | 28% | 9.32 | | R-1 only | 100% | 9.45 | At 0.58, sending 28% of pages to R-1 closes about 60% of the gap between R-1 mini and R-1. The curve keeps rising until about 60% of pages go to R-1, then goes flat. No threshold beats R-1 alone. 3 of the 780 pages carry the grader label "no page record". That is likely the grader timing out while it looks up the trace, not a routing error (not confirmed). Threshold curve, Nov 19: 597 judged pages At the live threshold 0.58, R-1 gets 19% of pages and closes about three quarters of the gap between R-1 mini and R-1. Over both days (1,608 pages) it is 24% of pages for about 64% of the gap (9.19, 9.37, 9.47). Same sweep as Nov 18, on pages judged from the 17:45 PT Nov 18 submit through 11:45 PT Nov 19. | Point | Pages sent to R-1 | Mean judge score | | --- | --- | --- | | R-1 mini only | 0% | 9.32 | | Live threshold 0.58 | 19% | 9.48 | | R-1 only | 100% | 9.53 | Left out of the curve: 103 pages from 2 of the 14 submits (05:45 and 07:45 PT). The routed dev class is no longer kept warm ([PR 15324](https://github.com/reductoai/api/pull/15324)) and did not start in time, so those pages ran on R-1 with no route head score. 5 of the 597 pages carry the grader label "no page record". Open questions: - Why 19% of pages were routed on Nov 19 against 28% on Nov 18. - Why 61 more judged pairs have no route head score, beyond the 103 pages of the two lost submits. Judged reads (mean judge score, R-1 / R-1 mini / auto\_route; pairs in parentheses) - 13:45 submit, 49 pairs: kept 9.58 / 9.36 / 9.45 (33), routed 8.13 / 7.93 / 8.20 (15). - 15:45 submit, 45 pairs: kept 9.65 / 9.65 / 9.70 (20), routed 8.14 / 7.81 / 8.57 (21). - The 5 pairs outside kept and routed (1 at 13:45, 4 at 15:45) were judged too; the grader found no page record for them. The four at 15:45 have one in the traces now (2 kept, 2 routed); the one at 13:45 has none. Stress test, routed build, one container - No failed request up to 512 in flight; no output garbled by load. - B200: 19.8 pages/s at 64 in flight (the earlier 11 pages/s was a B300 container). Gateway, streaming and the head cost nothing measurable. ## Impact - Shadow, threshold 0.58: 28% of pages to R-1; judge 9.32 vs 9.12 for R-1 mini alone and 9.45 for R-1 alone. Measured in shadow on prod traffic. - Nov 19 threshold curve, 597 judged pages: R-1 mini alone 9.32, routed at threshold 0.58 9.48 with 19% of pages sent to R-1, R-1 alone 9.53. Measured in shadow on prod traffic, 2026-11-19; refreshed daily. The routed shadow leg is no longer kept warm, so some submits miss it. - PR 1 [#15367](https://github.com/reductoai/api/pull/15367) gates, routed 128-seat variant vs today's pick (b200-n128), one B200 container, rep-1k: 30.45 vs 30.24 pages/s at 128 in flight; no failed request 1 to 512 in flight; 2,000 of 2,000 public-2k pages identical unrouted; 24 h shadow judge 9.31 vs 9.12 for R-1 mini alone. Measured on dev, 2026-11-18. - Stress test, routed build, one container on dev: no failed request up to 512 in flight; 19.8 pages/s at 64 in flight on a B200, 10.8 on a B300. - Shadow reliability ([#15221](https://github.com/reductoai/api/pull/15221), warm dev classes): before, a cold class lost every strict R-1 mini page of one submit (204 attempts); after, 53 of 53 and 52 of 52 succeeded. - GPU cost per 1k pages: estimate only, about \$0.10 routed at 28% against \$0.08 for R-1 mini and \$0.13 for R-1 (registry tables, at saturation). ### Routed Modal pick in prod ([#15367](https://github.com/reductoai/api/pull/15367)): not live yet (read 2026-11-19 09:45 PT) Prod still serves b200-n128. The routed pick 20261028-b200-nvfp4-route serves only in stg, because no prod release has shipped since #15367 merged at 2026-11-19 02:48 PT. The one prod release tried since then ([2026-11-19 09:38 PT](https://github.com/reductoai/api/actions/runs/44579409547)) failed the deployer allowlist: during the ElastiCache change, only raunakdoesdev, alvin-r and jingsong can deploy prod. Pick per environment, from modal app history of fpp-flash and the prod-deploy-record deployments: | Environment | Last fpp-flash deploy (PT) | Commit | R-1 mini pick | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | stg | 2026-11-19 07:55 (first with #15367: 02:59) | 2e17772 | 20261028-b200-nvfp4-route | | prod | 2026-11-18 17:41 | e3783a1 | b200-n128 | | prod\_eu | 2026-11-18 17:41 | e3783a1 | b200-n128 | | prod\_au | 2026-11-18 17:42 | e3783a1 | h100-int8 (as intended) | | dev | 2026-11-16 13:38, by hand | 019b311 | b200-n128 | The prod release alone should move none of the numbers below, since no prod request sets auto_route yet. If a number moves, the unrouted path regressed. Before (pick b200-n128): Modal fpp-flash class R1Mini, ok model.call rows, shadows excluded. Days are UTC days, which run 16:00 PT to 16:00 PT. | Day | Region | Modal pages | Peak pages/s | Peak pages/s per ready container | p50 / p99 (s) | Failed attempts | Modal share of R-1 mini pages | Modal \$ | \$ per 1k Modal pages | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 11-17 | US | 262,727 | 321 | 26.0 | 1.01 / 11.3 | 10,720 (3.9%, HTTP 503) | 18.1% | 1,094 | 4.16 | | 11-18 | US | 6,003,835 | 3,593 | 15.0 | 0.85 / 4.4 | 151,038 (2.5%, HTTP 429) | 80.8% | 1,843 (estimate) | 0.31 | | 11-19, to 09:40 PT | US | 74,281 | 54 | 12.5 | 1.23 / 5.6 | 0 | 8.2% | not billed yet | | | 11-17 | EU | 14,652 | 39 | 8.6 | 1.51 / 6.2 | 0 | 100% | 253 | 17.3 | | 11-18 | EU | 17,092 | 32 | 5.3 | 1.92 / 4.2 | 1 | 100% | 720 (estimate) | 42.1 | | 11-19, to 09:40 PT | EU | 2,919 | 4 | 4.0 | 1.78 / 6.1 | 0 | 100% | not billed yet | | How to read the before table: - Modal share is the US fallback rate. In the US, Modal gets only the router's overflow from the GPU clusters. EU has no cluster, so it runs all of R-1 mini on Modal. - Bursts skew 11-17 and 11-18. On 11-18, two bursts (11-17 16:00 to 18:00 PT and 11-18 11:00 to 13:00 PT) sent 5.9M pages to Modal, which scaled to 350 R1Mini containers. On 11-17, one hour (14:00 PT) carried 192k of the 263k pages. Compare the after window against hours of equal volume. - Cost per 1k Modal pages tracks the warm floor, not the pages: 4.16 USD at 263k pages, 0.31 USD at 6.0M. Compare it only between days of equal volume. - Prod containers peak below the benchmark. Before the merge, one B200 at 128 in flight did 30.45 pages/s routed and 30.24 control. The router gives each prod container 32 calls, so prod peaks lower. After: fill in from the first full UTC day after the prod release that carries #15367.
